program = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r != c and grid[r][c] != 0]
        base = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = grid[r][c] if r == c and grid[r][c] != 0 else base
    return out
'''

program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = []
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(c + 1, h) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        base.append(vals[0] if vals else None)
    known = [i for i, v in enumerate(base) if v is not None]
    # The lower triangle gives the unshifted repeating row pattern.
    period = next(p for p in range(1, len(known) + 1)
                  if all(base[i] == base[i % p] for i in known if i >= p))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r > c:
                out[r][c] = base[c]
            else:
                out[r][c] = base[(c - 1) % period]
    return out
'''
